description: Write and edit Mermaid sequence diagrams, delivered as fenced ```mermaid code blocks that render directly in Markdown (GitHub, GitLab, most wikis), validated and previewed through a Mermaid MCP server when one is connected (mermaid-cli or mermaid.live otherwise). Use this skill whenever the user wants to show how parts of a system interact over time — "sequence diagram", "draw the login flow", "diagram how the frontend talks to the API", "document this request/response chain", "show what happens when a user checks out", "diagram this webhook" — even if they never say "Mermaid" or "sequence diagram".

results.query: diagram how the frontend talks to the API and the API talks to the cache and DB when a user loads their dashboard — show the order of calls
show what happens step by step when a customer checks out: cart service, inventory check, payment, order creation, confirmation email
draw a sequence diagram of our login flow: browser → BFF → Keycloak → BFF → browser, including the token exchange. put it in markdown for the wiki
document this webhook flow as a diagram — Stripe sends us the event, we verify the signature, enqueue it, and ack. show the failure path too if the signature is bad
i need a sequence diagram for the password reset: user requests reset, we email a token, they submit new password, we validate and update
desenha um diagrama de sequência mostrando a comunicação entre o app mobile, o gateway e o serviço de notificações no envio de push
diagram the retry/backoff interaction between our worker and the third-party API when it returns 429s — as a mermaid block
show the message flow for our async order processing: producer publishes to Kafka, consumer picks it up, calls the fulfillment service, emits an event
i want to visualize the OAuth authorization code flow with PKCE as a sequence — client, auth server, resource server, all the round trips
create a diagram of the request/response chain when our API gateway authenticates a call, checks rate limits, then forwards to the upstream service
create the C4 container diagram for our platform in workspace.dsl
draw an ER diagram of our orders database in mermaid — tables and relationships
make a flowchart in mermaid of our deployment decision logic (the if/else branches)
create a gantt chart in mermaid for our Q3 roadmap
write a design doc for the new event pipeline, with the flow of data between services
document how our microservices are structured and connected at a high level using C4
record our decision to use Mermaid for all docs diagrams as an ADR
draw our team's org chart
explain how the OAuth authorization code flow works
set up mermaid-cli in our build so diagrams render in CI
